title: Local Manager update recovery and Production release parity

phases.objective: Recover safely from empty update and pairing rate-limit responses, and publish the public Windows executable only when the Hostinger Production runtime has reached the exact release commit.

e2e_journeys.actor: Linked Mad4B Local Manager Windows app
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A desktop checks for an update while the shared auth host is rate limited, then receives an update after the Production release gate passes.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Empty or invalid responses produce bounded retry diagnostics without a JSON exception; the public 0.2.30 executable is released only after the Production runtime reports the exact release commit.
steps: Check HTTP response status before JSON parsing and handle an empty rate-limit response.
Respect bounded Retry-After values for pairing and desktop command polling.
Build a Windows executable whose version matches the update route metadata.
Verify Hostinger health and exact Production commit through version and deployment-info before publishing the public release.
assertions: Empty or invalid update responses never throw a JSON parsing exception into the desktop UI.
A rate limit does not authorize connector repair or disclose credentials.
The Windows executable and release owner route agree on version 0.2.30.
A main or pull-request build cannot publish the public executable.
No Production deployment, migration, grant, or credential mutation is performed by this candidate.
